title: Hota rahega hashr talak matame Hussain
body:
HOTA RAHEGA HASHR TALAK MATAM-E-HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaye hai karbala ki fazaon se ye sada
Qurbaan tere sabr ke aye Shahe Karbala
Ummat ke bakshwane ko sar tune dediya
<<MINI>>
Hota rahega hashr talak Matam-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Bardta rahega Ahle Aza ka ye qafela
Dunya ke rokne se ye ab tak nahi ruka
Saaye ki tarha sath jo Zainab ki dua hai
<<MINI>>
Hota rahega hashr talak Matam-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyasa huwa shaheed dil-o-jaan-e-Fatima
Kaise bhulayega koi ahsaan-e-Fatima
Pesh-e-nazar hamhare hai armaan-e-Fatima
<<MINI>>
Hota rahega hashr talak Matam-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Khakar sina kaleje pe Akber huwe shaheed
Aur teer-e-zulm se Ali Asghar huwe shaheed
Yuin karbala mein Shah ke dilbar huwe shaheed
<<MINI>>
Hota rahega hashr talak Matam-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Lasha Hasan ke laal ka pamaal hogaya
Bazu kata ke sogae Abbas-e-bawa
Khanjar se shumr ke kata Shabbir ka gala
<<MINI>>
Hota rahega hashr talak Matam-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Hoti jo mere sar pe rida aye Shahe Zaman
Rehti ne jalti reit pe yuin lash bekafan
Bhaye ke lash par yunhi kehti rahi bahen
<<MINI>>
Hota rahega hashr talak Matam-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil se gham-e-Hussain manate raho Nazar
Palkon pe apne ashk-e-sajate raho Nazar
Har pal duae Fatima pate raho Nazar
<<MINI>>
Hota rahega hashr talak Matam-e-Hussain
